title: Keep experimental halving estimators out of wildcard exports
answers: Why does from sklearn.model_selection import * raise ImportError?
Can experimental halving search estimators be added to __all__?
How should model_selection expose HalvingGridSearchCV and HalvingRandomSearchCV?
body:
Symptom: Star-importing sklearn.model_selection fails with an ImportError about enabling halving search.
Root cause: sklearn/model_selection/__init__.py:__all__ listed HalvingGridSearchCV and HalvingRandomSearchCV, whose access is rejected by sklearn/model_selection/__init__.py:__getattr__ until enable_halving_search_cv is imported.
Fix pattern: Exclude gated estimators from __all__; retain their TYPE_CHECKING imports with # noqa: F401 for static visibility.
Constraints: Applies while these estimators are experimental. Preserve the guidance error on explicit access before opt-in and their importability after opt-in; revisit the type-checking workaround when they cease to be experimental.
applies: Changes to model_selection exports and experimental halving-search exposure.
